entities.summary: Mercedes María Paz is a former professional tennis player from Argentina. She won three singles titles on the WTA Tour and reached a career-high ranking of world No. 28 in April 1991. Her best Grand Slam result was the fourth round at the 1986 French Open and the 1990 French Open. Mercedes Paz was a athletes & competitors from San Miguel de Tucumán (b. 1966-06-27, San Miguel de Tucumán). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
